description: Generate a real RFC 5545 .ics calendar file for a meeting (title, start/end, attendees, location, description). Produces the file content — it does not send invitations.
name: schedule_meeting
provider_notes: Pure generator — builds a standards-compliant .ics (RFC 5545) from inputs. No calendar provider is contacted; no invitation is sent. Sending goes through send_email (with approval) or the user's own calendar client. Demo output is real .ics text, not a simulated provider.
